title: Arc Relay forward combat — labelled operation review
intro: Outcome-visible review of the final forward-facing combat rules and stock mind. Each card explains the causal trigger, intended tactic, legal counterplay, fallback, match result, and verified prepare-to-release window. Operation success and match victory are separate facts.

cards.title: Escort Counterpunch — Blue operation
cards.subtitle: Blue operation vs Baseline · Blue wins by reactor destroyed at t356 · prepare t53→commit t59→success t60→release t61 · baseline resumed
cards.trigger: Blue has a Core carrier under visible pressure at the return fork and can claim one declared guard.
cards.tactic: Pause the carrier and guard together, read the visible threat count, then lock either the counter route or the direct home route instead of oscillating between them.
cards.counterplay: Separate the guard from the carrier, cover both fork exits, or force the Core loose before the route decision completes.
cards.fallback: Core loss aborts immediately. A guard lost after commitment is not silently replaced; surviving bodies release to their baseline jobs.
cards.watch: Preparation begins at t53, the route locks at t59, the carrier reaches its home half at t60, and both participants release at t61. Blue later wins the match.

cards.title: Emergency Exchange — Blue operation
cards.subtitle: Blue operation vs Baseline · Blue wins by reactor destroyed at t436 · prepare t101→commit t102→success t113→release t114 · baseline resumed
cards.trigger: A wounded Blue carrier is visible in the risk fork while the declared Switchback is alive and able to reach it.
cards.tactic: Pull the Switchback out of interception duty, bring it to the carrier, then use Exchange to swap the endangered carrier onto the safer homeward position.
cards.counterplay: Finish or displace the carrier before the Switchback arrives, deny a legal swap position, or isolate and destroy the Switchback en route.
cards.fallback: Core loss or either required participant's loss aborts. A late Switchback arrival cannot manufacture success after the rescue window.
cards.watch: Blue commits at t102, Exchange fires at t112, an own carrier is safely on the home half at t113, and the operation releases at t114. Blue later wins at t436 without entering the old pickup/drop loop.

cards.title: Birth Rotation — Blue operation
cards.subtitle: Blue operation vs Baseline · Orange wins by reactor destroyed at t412 · prepare t373→commit t379→success t386→release t388 · baseline resumed
cards.trigger: The next Well birth is publicly approaching and at least two of Blue's three declared reserves can rotate.
cards.tactic: Move any feasible pair across theaters before the birth so two bodies arrive in the forward objective band instead of reacting after the Core appears.
cards.counterplay: Threaten Blue's home hard enough to force an abort, occupy the rotation lanes, or exploit the theaters the two reserves vacate.
cards.fallback: A visible home overload cancels the rotation. Losses are absorbed by the declared reserve pool and surviving rotators return to baseline.
cards.watch: Blue prepares at t373, commits two rotators at t379, reaches the target band at t386, and releases at t388. The operation succeeds, but Orange still wins the match at t412.

cards.title: Smoke Breach — Blue operation
cards.subtitle: Blue operation vs Baseline · Orange wins by reactor destroyed at t355 · prepare t255→commit t264→success t273→release t277 · baseline resumed
cards.trigger: Blue sees meaningful resistance in the centre and can stage a Veil with one declared breacher.
cards.tactic: Concentrate the pair in one lane, deploy Smoke Canister, then cross the contested centre while the smoke disrupts clean targeting.
cards.counterplay: Use Hush to suppress the cover, wait outside the smoke and hold its exit, flank the lane, or create a three-enemy home emergency that forces Blue to disengage.
cards.fallback: A severe home threat aborts the breach; otherwise the exposed pair gets a bounded extraction before ordinary theater roles resume.
cards.watch: Smoke is deployed during preparation at t255, the pair commits at t264, both cross centre-forward by t273, and release at t277. The tactic works even though Orange wins at t355.

cards.title: Lantern Sweep — Blue operation
cards.subtitle: Blue operation vs Baseline · Orange wins by reactor destroyed at t402 · prepare t53→commit t59→success t60→release t61 · baseline resumed
cards.trigger: A Blue carrier reaches a safe return fork while the route is uncertain and a Lantern plus screen are available to probe it.
cards.tactic: Pause the carrier, use the Lantern-screen pair to reveal risk, then choose the alternate route when danger is visible or the ordered primary route when it is clear.
cards.counterplay: Remove the Lantern before it resolves the fork, conceal pressure until after commitment, collapse the chosen lane, or force the carrier to drop the Core.
cards.fallback: Core loss aborts. The chosen branch never thrashes to the other route, and surviving participants extract back to baseline.
cards.watch: The probe prepares at t53, locks one return branch at t59, gets the carrier onto its home half at t60, and releases at t61. Orange later wins the wider match.

cards.title: Decoy Switch — Blue operation
cards.subtitle: Blue operation vs Baseline · Orange wins by reactor destroyed at t402 · prepare t9→commit t15→success t25→release t29 · baseline resumed
cards.trigger: Public Well timing and visible north-side pressure make a north decoy and a declared south strike pair simultaneously feasible.
cards.tactic: Show one body north to hold attention, then lock the opposite pair into the south lane and concede centre coverage long enough to create the switch.
cards.counterplay: Do not overreact to the lone decoy; retain vision and a reserve south, cut the pair's lane, or overload Blue's home to trigger the abort.
cards.fallback: A home overload cancels the switch. Otherwise the decoy and hitters pay their positional cost, then all survivors return to baseline.
cards.watch: Blue begins the feint at t9, commits the south pincer at t15, gets both hitters into south-forward by t25, and releases at t29. Orange ultimately wins at t402.

cards.title: Rear Hook — Blue operation
cards.subtitle: Blue operation vs Balanced · Orange wins by reactor destroyed at t376 · prepare t186→commit t203→success t219→release t231 · baseline resumed
cards.trigger: Public Well timing and visible forward pressure let two Towlines infiltrate; commitment waits for an observed enemy carrier inside its return corridor.
cards.tactic: Give up ordinary Well pressure to place the Towlines behind the line, lock onto the exact carrier, then use Tractor Hook to make that Core loose or Blue-owned.
cards.counterplay: Screen the carrier, vary its return route before commitment, reveal and kill a staging Towline, or punish the objectives Blue vacated to set the trap.
cards.fallback: Loss of a required stager before commitment aborts. After commitment an optional survivor may continue, but the deadline always releases it.
cards.watch: The ambush prepares at t186, commits at t203, uses Tractor Hook at t203 and t209, succeeds at t219, and releases at t231. Orange wins the wider match at t376; its carriers keep progressing rather than oscillating near home.

cards.title: Hardlight Gate — Blue operation
cards.subtitle: Blue operation vs Baseline · Orange wins by reactor destroyed at t376 · prepare t57→commit t69→success t70→release t71 · baseline resumed
cards.trigger: A pressured Blue return can claim both its declared Lantern and Mason to form a protected homeward gate.
cards.tactic: Pull the utility pair off objective work, place Hardlight Block across the dangerous approach, and hold the gate long enough for the carrier to cross home.
cards.counterplay: Suppress or bypass the construct, attack the Mason before placement, displace a gate participant, fire over or around the block, or force the Core loose.
cards.fallback: Core loss aborts. After success the gate pair physically extracts before resuming ordinary objective assignments.
cards.watch: Blue prepares the gate at t57, commits once it is formed at t69, gets the carrier home at t70, and releases at t71. Orange still wins the match at t376.

cards.title: Relay Catch — Blue operation
cards.subtitle: Blue operation vs Hook Burst · Orange wins by reactor destroyed at t380 · prepare t76→commit t77→success t80→release t84 · baseline resumed
cards.trigger: The assigned south Relay carries a Core and its paired Relay receiver is alive on the safer homeward side.
cards.tactic: Hold the receiver behind the carrier, use Arc Toss to move possession across the dangerous gap, then let the specifically assigned receiver complete the return.
cards.counterplay: Block or attack the catch lane, displace or destroy the receiver, pressure the carrier before the toss, or force a drop that breaks the assigned handoff.
cards.fallback: The expected one-tick in-flight possession gap is tolerated; a genuinely missed catch times out and releases both Relays to baseline.
cards.watch: Blue prepares at t76, commits at t77, throws with Arc Toss at t78, the receiver owns the Core at t80, and both release at t84. Orange wins the wider match at t380; neither side trips stationary-carrier behavior.

cards.title: Fork Shadow — Blue operation
cards.subtitle: Blue operation vs Baseline · Blue wins by reactor destroyed at t465 · prepare t93→commit t103→success t124→release t136 · baseline resumed
cards.trigger: Blue gains causal sight of an enemy carrier returning through a north or south fork while two Towlines can reach a cutoff.
cards.tactic: React late to the revealed route, choose exactly one north-or-south cutoff, and keep that branch locked while the Towlines force the carrier off it with Tractor Hook.
cards.counterplay: Break vision before the target is fresh enough to commit, change route early, screen the selected cutoff, or exploit that the locked branch will not chase the opposite lane.
cards.fallback: The branch never flips. An optional strike partner may die without freezing the survivor, and the recovery deadline returns it to baseline.
cards.watch: Blue prepares at t93, commits the observed cutoff at t103, uses Tractor Hook during the pursuit, succeeds at t124, and releases at t136. Blue wins at t465.
